feature: Transform values behind an Info button on the tool bar
summary: Nothing about a layer's transform floats over the picture any more. With something picked, the tool bar has an Info button at its right end; it opens the layer's X, Y, W, H, Rotation (and the 3D values once it is turned) in a popover rising out of the bar, in the bar's own glass, that slides aside from any handle.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. Walks: transform-values-info-walk, show-transform-values-menu-walk.

try.do: Open a recording and click the picture with Select (V) to pick the whole recording.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click the (i) button at the right end of the tool bar.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click X, type 100 and press Return.
Drag the recording on the canvas with the popover open and watch X and Y.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Type 15 into Rotation, then click Reset.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Escape, then press F8 (or Layer > Show Transform Values) to open it again.
Pick the Text tool (T) and see the popover close.

evaluate: Does the popover read as part of the tool bar it rose out of (same glass, same corner)?
With a full-canvas recording picked, are the top handles and the 3D arcs always in plain sight?
Is the Info button where you would look for it, and is F8 the key you would reach for?
Is it right that the values never open by themselves on a drag, only when you ask?
Does the tool bar shifting by one button when you pick or let go of something bother you?
rough: video-animate.html still draws the old bar under the layer; your own words on 2026-10-12 replace it (your call on 2026-10-12), and the mock is left as drawn.
The tool bar is centred, so Info coming and going with the pick moves both ends of the bar by about 20 points, instantly (the 10.7 rule: no spring on a selection).
On a short canvas with the timeline open, the 3D list (nine rows) is about 260 points tall and covers a good part of the picture's lower right, though never a handle.
The key overlay on the timeline (clicking a key to type its value) is not built yet; its task now says it must use this popover's look (clicking-a-key-opens-the-same-overlay-to-set-tha).
With the popover closed, a drag shows the old drag readout pill again, as it did before the bar.
